title: Firearms Licensing Administrator
description:
Adecco are pleased to be recruiting for a Firearms Licensing Administrator to work within the Devon & Cornwall Police Force

Location: Exeter
Working Pattern: Full Time, Monday to Friday 37 hours per week
Hourly Rate: 13.33 per hour

Contract: Temporary until March 2027

Please note this role will be subject to Police Vetting, you will need to have resided within the UK for a minimum of 3 years

Are you ready to embark on a rewarding journey in public service? Our client is seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic Firearms Licensing Administrator to join their dynamic firearms licensing team! If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for delivering exceptional administrative support, we want to hear from you!

About the Role:

As a Firearms Licensing Administrator, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that all firearms licensing applications are processed efficiently and in compliance with legal standards. Your responsibilities will include:

Processing Applications: Manage and flag any concerns regarding applications, ensuring that all activities support lawful firearms usage.
Customer Support: Serve as the friendly face of the team, providing expert guidance to callers regarding all aspects of firearms licensing.
Payment Management: Handle and process payments for certificates with accuracy and attention to detail.
Mail Management: Receive, sort, and distribute a high volume of mail and emails, ensuring smooth communication flow.
Applicant Checks: Conduct checks on applicants using Force intelligence systems to uphold safety and compliance.
Document Management: Accurately record, scan, and archive application documents, maintaining organised records in our databases.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and suggest opportunities for process enhancements to improve team efficiency.

Who We Are Looking For:

To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications and skills:
- IT Proficiency: Experience using IT systems, including Microsoft Office applications.
- Customer Care Skills: Demonstrable ability to provide exceptional service.
- Organisational Skills: Strong ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines effectively.
- Administrative Expertise: Proven administrative skills with attention to detail.
- Communication Skills: Good verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with colleagues and the public.

Competencies:

We value individuals who are:
- Emotionally aware and take ownership of their responsibilities.
- Collaborative team players who support and inspire others.
- Critical thinkers who analyse situations and provide innovative solutions.

Why Join Us?

Impactful Work: Contribute to public safety and support lawful firearms activity within your community.
Professional Growth: Opportunities for role-specific training and development in firearms legislation and administration.
Supportive Environment: Work within a team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are passionate about public service and meet the criteria above, we invite you to apply for the Firearms Licensing Administrator position today! Join our client in making a positive impact in Exeter and surrounding areas.

Application Process:

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their CV and a cover letter highlighting their relevant experience and skills.

We can't wait to see how you can contribute to our team's success!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: ExeterDepartment: FinanceSalary: £28,000 Working hours: Full-time. Hybrid working.

We are supporting a client in Exeter with the recruitment of an Accounts Assistant. This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy finance team during a period of operational change, offering varied exposure across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Master Data. About the Role

This role offers broad financial administration experience, with responsibilities rotating in line with business needs. - Posting purchase ledger invoices

- Supporting weekly payment runs

- Providing project and cross-functional support as required

- Previous experience within Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, or a general finance support role (1 year)

- Ability to manage queries professionally and efficiently
- A proactive attitude with the willingness to learn new systems and processes
- Ability to reliably commute to Exeter is a must

How to apply:

This role is available as soon as the right candidate is found so do not delay. There is plenty of free parking and good access to public transport. The hours are full time only. For more information please contact Stefanie Farber at Butler Rose Finance Recruitment: . Alternatively apply with a full and relevant CV.

title: Customer Service Adviser
description:
Customer Service Adviser

£25,128 - £29,296 per annum

Barnstaple

Permanent, Full Time

Are you a team player and love working alongside colleagues throughout the business to deliver a first-class service to customers?

Are you a whizz at computers and can get up to speed on a variety of computer systems in no time?

Are you resilient and can keep a cool head under pressure, turning tricky situations into positive ones?

If so, this could be the role for you!

North Devon Homes (NDH) is a registered charity providing affordable homes for people who need them. We are a housing association covering the North Devon area and have over 3,300 homes we provide accommodation to over 10,000 customers.

We're now seeking a Customer Service Adviser - someone to act as first point of contact for our customers, ensuring queries (whether that be by phone, in person, or email) are dealt with in a positive, professional, and helpful manner. You will resolve issues or effectively signpost customers to specialist teams and partner agencies, giving informed guidance on a variety of NDH services to include repairs, rent enquiries, anti-social behaviour queries and other housing related matters. No two calls or days are the same!

We're looking for someone who is able to offer advice and practical solutions to customers. With strong communication skills and an excellent telephone manner, you'll be able to deal tactfully with a wide range of customers and always remain empathetic, calm, and courteous.

You'll have a high level of diplomacy skills to enable effective negotiations with both internal and external groups and be a strong team player, able to positively contribute to team goals.

Your starting salary will reflect any direct experience you can bring, and as there'll be so much for you to learn, support and guidance will be provided to help you reach your potential through graduated salary increments up to a possible £29,296.

If this sounds like what you're looking for and you want the opportunity to make a difference to our customers' lives, we want to hear from you!

In return for your hard work, we can offer you a wealth of benefits;
- 27 days holiday plus Bank Holidays
- 7% Employer Contribution Pension
- Cash Plan of up to £1,600 per year
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

title: Sales Support Lead
description:
Sales Support Lead
Location: Bideford, Devon
Job Type: Full-time, on-site
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000

Hours: Monday to Friday 8.30am - 5pm
About the Opportunity

We are looking for a friendly, organised and reliable Sales Support Lead to join our team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role, likes working with people and takes pride in keeping things organised and running smoothly.

Working alongside the wider team, you will provide day-to-day administrative and customer support, helping to ensure a positive experience for customers and effective communication across the business.

The Role
The role will involve a variety of administrative and sales support activities, including:
- Responding to customer sales enquiries by telephone and email
- Assisting with the processing and coordination of customer requirements
- Manage and take the lead on complex customer service enquiries
- Keeping information and records accurate and up to date
- Communicating with customers, colleagues and external contacts
- Helping to ensure tasks are followed through efficiently
- Providing general administrative support as required
- Raising purchase orders and processing sales orders with accuracy
- Assisting with the smooth running of the office and wider team

About You
You will be someone who is:
- Organised and able to manage a varied workload effectively
- Confident handling customer enquiries and finding practical solutions
- Able to assess situations, make sensible commercial decisions and take ownership of customer issues
- Calm and resourceful when dealing with more challenging or complex queries
- Thorough, with a strong eye for accuracy and detail
- Responsive and able to prioritise effectively to ensure customers receive timely support
- Adaptable and willing to take a flexible, hands-on approach to your work
- Confident communicating with customers, colleagues and external contacts
- A positive team player who is happy to use initiative and get involved
- Experienced in administration, customer service, sales support or a similar environment
- Comfortable using computers and everyday office systems

Previous experience within a sales or customer service role, preferably within a manufacturing environment would be desired.

What We Offer
- A friendly and supportive working environment
- A varied role with plenty of opportunity to get involved
- Company pension
- Cycle to work scheme
- Free on-site parking

Location
This is a full-time, on-site position based in Bideford, Devon.
If you are organised, personable and looking for a varied role within a supportive team, we would love to hear from you.
